title: Dimensional Modeling Deep Dive
description: Master the harder modeling decisions: choosing the right grain under ambiguity, SCD Type 2 vs 3 tradeoffs, bridge table design, conformed vs role-playing dimensions, wide vs normalized models, and schema design from complex business requirements.
outcomes: You'll reason confidently about grain declaration under competing reporting needs, choose between SCD types for real scenarios, model many-to-many relationships with bridge tables, distinguish conformed from role-playing dimensions, and decide when a wide table beats a star schema.
